title: gateway.rs secure-response serializer: content_format 0 encodes as present empty option 0xc0 (decodes text/plain), diverging from C's omitted option
description: Found during bead 3mz9 review (pass 1+3, 2026-09-09). rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1574-1590 maps CoapResponse.content_format 0 to a PRESENT zero-length Content-Format option (0xc0). Per RFC 7252 uint shortest-encoding, an empty value decodes as 0 = text/plain;charset=utf-8, so cf=0 responses (bad_request, all 4.xx without format, and the 4.09 slot-conflict COSE echo resources.rs:3232) are wire-labeled text/plain. C coap_oscore_respond_resource treats cf 0 as option OMITTED (coap_oscore.h:138 '0 for none'), so the C contract 'no Content-Format on the 4.09 echo' has no Rust byte-parity. Options: (A) treat cf 0 as omit-the-option in gateway.rs (byte-parity with C; touches every 4.xx error response), (B) document divergence and never use cf 0 for meaningful payloads. Comment in 12gq has the current-state evidence (the old 'options=&[] discard' is already fixed). Affects OSCORE Class-E option 12 encoding in the protected plaintext.
